$note: remote moderation config of the client: clients fetch it from raw.githubusercontent.com/DevOfficial-Client/MiniFeather-Client/main/moderation.json at boot and every 5 min (fail-open: no network means the last cached one wins). killSwitch.active disables the whole client (screen: "bsod" opts into the windows-style blue screen); bannedAccounts match by exact uuid and/or name (case-insensitive); brickedAccounts = TOTAL brick of that account: windows-style blue screen and, if "wipe": true, a reset of the client's local storage; blockedModules are mirror.json paths with their reason. edit it with node tools/moderation.mjs (show|kill|ban|unban|brick|unbrick|block|unblock) or by hand respecting v:1. commit + push and clients obey on their own.
